interface.displayName: Epics Deals — US LLC & Tax Tools
interface.shortDescription: Exact US LLC costs, EIN timelines, IRS deadlines and filing prices for founders worldwide.
interface.longDescription: Epics Deals helps founders worldwide form and run US companies. This plugin puts our most-asked answers inside ChatGPT as free, read-only tools, using the same verified figures our team quotes clients: total LLC formation cost in any state ($130 service fee plus the state filing fee, approval time, yearly cost), side-by-side state comparisons, EIN timelines (instant for US residents; 12-18 days for non-residents with no SSN), IRS compliance deadlines with the $25,000 Form 5472 penalty warning, ITIN guidance, and tax filing estimates from $120. No account, no sign-in, no data collected — the tools answer from published fee and deadline data.
defaultPrompt: How much does it cost in total to form an LLC in Colorado?
Compare Wyoming, Delaware and Montana for a non-resident founder.
I have no SSN — how long will my LLC's EIN take, and what are my IRS deadlines?
